newsitem.title: UK: Dentsu takes part in Beijing, Shanghai exhibitions.
newsitem.headline: Dentsu takes part in Beijing, Shanghai exhibitions.

text.p: Dentsu Inc, the world's largest advertising agency, said on Thursday it was the first Japanese ad agency to take part in big advertising and television festivals in China this month.

Tokyo-based Dentsu said in a statement received in London that it opened the first booth by a Japanese advertising agency at the 2nd Beijing International Advertising Fair & Famous Trademark Exhibition from November 7 to 11.
Dentsu held an advertising seminar at the Beijing exhibition and another in Shanghai on November 12, as part of a Shanghai television festival.
Dentsu's seminars focussed on changes taking place within Japanese advertising and on Dentsu's 1996 advertising awards.

The statement said Dentsu's booth at the Beijing exhibition, in which 547 companies and organisations from 37 countries participated, was only the third Dentsu had ever set up at an overseas exhibition.

Dentsu said it also held a reception in Shanghai for about 300 guests, including representatives of the Shanghai City Council, Chinese broadcasting companies and executives from Dentsu client companies.
Advertising industry executives say Dentsu is trying to expand its business, with has been mostly confined to Japan, to other countries around Asia.
